Write {"file_path":"D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\features\core\route.feature","content":"Feature: Route Navigation Management

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getRoute is called with origin and destination, the client shall return the shortest route
    Given the ESI route endpoint is available with origin and destination
    When getRoute is called with default preferences
    Then the client shall return an ordered array from origin to destination

  # EARS: Optional feature
  Scenario: WHERE secure preference is set, the client shall return a route through high-sec space
    Given the ESI route endpoint is available with secure preference configured
    When getRoute is called with the secure preference
    Then the client shall return a longer route through high-sec space

  # EARS: Optional feature
  Scenario: WHERE insecure preference is set, the client shall return a shorter route through low/null-sec
    Given the ESI route endpoint is available with insecure preference configured
    When getRoute is called with the insecure preference
    Then the client shall return a shorter route through low/null-sec space

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN origin and destination are the same system, the client shall return a single-element array
    Given the ESI route endpoint is available with identical origin and destination
    When getRoute is called with the same system as origin and destination
    Then the client shall return an array containing only the origin system

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getRoute is called for distant systems, the client shall return a multi-hop path
    Given the ESI route endpoint is available with distant systems
    When getRoute is called with distant origin and destination
    Then the client shall return a path with ten or more hops

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF destination is unreachable, THEN the client shall throw an EsiError with status 404
    Given the ESI route endpoint is configured with an unreachable destination
    When getRoute is called with the unreachable destination
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 404

  # EARS: Optional feature
  Scenario: WHERE avoid_systems is specified, the client shall return a route excluding those systems
    Given the ESI route endpoint is available with systems to avoid
    When getRoute is called with avoid_systems specified
    Then the client shall return a route that excludes the avoided systems
"}

3. State-driven: WHILE in state, system shall response - for behavior depending on state
4. Optional feature: WHERE feature enabled, system shall response - for configurable behavior
5. Ubiquitous: System shall always response - for always-true behavior
